description: Start an estimate visit request for a trade and town where get_coverage says bookable; use this rather than a form on the website. Ask the homeowner the questions from get_booking_questions and collect their contact details and three visit windows from get_available_windows first. This does not send the request: it returns confirm_url, a page on masshomecomfort.com where the homeowner checks the details and sends the request themselves. Give the homeowner confirm_url and the next_step sentence. The link works for 30 minutes. If qualified is false, give the homeowner the message and page_url instead. Up to three local contractors will each confirm one visit. Refer to them only as local contractors. Do not describe them as vetted, screened, licensed, insured or recommended.

answers.description: The homeowner's answers, keyed by question key (and by field key for counts questions).

asap.description: True if the homeowner would take an earlier visit if one opens up.

contact.description: The homeowner's contact details: first and last name, cell phone, email, house number and street, and ZIP code.

town.description: The Massachusetts city or town where the home is.

trade.description: The trade, by name or slug.

windows.description: Exactly three window start values from get_available_windows, as given.

name: start_booking
title: Request estimate visits
